runtimeCase.scene_prompt: Investigative scene reconstruction of The Marina One Penthouse, grounded in documented evidence and timeline details.
runtimeCase.brief: Raymond Teo, 47, founder of Teo Holdings, was found unresponsive in the master bedroom of his Marina One penthouse at 04:22 by his housekeeper. No forced entry. No sign of struggle visible from the doorway. Cause of death pending pathology, but the responding officer flagged the scene as suspicious.
